explanation: Compared against erdosproblems.com/775: Spencer constructed graphs with cliques of at least n − log₂ n + O(1) distinct sizes. The statement gives ∃ C such that for every n there is a graph on Fin n with |cliqueSizes G| ≥ n − log₂ n − C, where cliqueSizes is the set of sizes of maximal cliques. Faithful.
